scientific_ceiling: Retrospective Atlantic hurricane structural-coherence discrimination only. No independent-human route-identification, outcome-blind, prospective, causal, universal-law, or universal-invariant confirmation claim.
noncompensation_between_studies: This hurricane arm is noncompensating with all prior UCIC arms. A favorable result cannot rescue the adverse FDIC longitudinal result; an adverse result cannot erase separately supported prior arms.

source.reason_for_2004_cutoff: NHC documents storm-size fields beginning in 2004.

eligibility.zero_radius_interpretation: Observed zero is retained as absence of that threshold wind in that quadrant and is not treated as missing.
temporal_requirements: same-storm observation exactly 24 hours earlier for history comparator
same-storm observation exactly 24 hours later for target

frozen_structural_representation.threshold_symmetry: For each of 34, 50, and 64 kt radii: min(NE,SE,SW,NW) / max(NE,SE,SW,NW), with observed zeros retained; if max radius is zero the threshold symmetry is zero.
frozen_structural_representation.nesting_quality: Fraction of the eight adjacent threshold relations across four quadrants satisfying r34 >= r50 and r50 >= r64, with all radii nonnegative.
frozen_structural_representation.interpretive_boundary: These are frozen wind-field geometric relation proxies, not independently established constitutive routes. Failure of the proxy does not by itself falsify the full constitutive-route premise.

STATE_HISTORY_LOGISTIC.training: Fit only on 2004-2018 eligible observations; apply unchanged to 2019-2025 holdout.

STATE_HISTORY_PLUS_UCIC.training: Fit only on 2004-2018 eligible observations; apply unchanged to 2019-2025 holdout.

comparators.UCIC_SCORE_ONLY: Direct scalar AUC of ucic_noncompensatory_score on holdout.
comparators.ADDITIVE_STRUCTURAL_ONLY: Direct scalar AUC of additive_structural_comparator on holdout.

terminal_rules_in_order.when: Any minimum evaluability threshold fails, acquisition fails, required source schema is absent, or either class is absent for a required AUC.
incremental_auc >= 0.02 AND bootstrap_95pct_ci_lower > 0 AND additive_structural_auc > ucic_only_auc + 0.02
incremental_auc >= 0.02 AND bootstrap_95pct_ci_lower > 0 AND additive_structural_auc <= ucic_only_auc + 0.02

stopping_rule: Perform one complete deterministic acquisition and scoring pass after this protocol is frozen. No post-result change to years, eligibility, structural score, target, comparators, optimizer, metrics, bootstrap, thresholds, or terminal logic is permitted. Technical-only source transport or parser corrections are permitted only if scientific semantics remain unchanged and the failed attempt is preserved.
